# Decide Football

Decide Football (https://decidefootball.com) is an independent fantasy football decision site. It helps with roster calls: start/sit, listed availability, waivers, add/drop, and weekly positional rankings. It uses structured estimates (floor, mean, ceiling). It is not a sports news blog, not gambling advice, and not affiliated with the NFL or its member clubs.

## Indexable pages

- https://decidefootball.com/about/
- https://decidefootball.com/methodology/
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/ — Hub for how to read this desk's decision cards: start/sit (mean, floor, ceiling, certainty), injury designations (Questionable, Doubtful, Out, injured reserve, and inactive), waiver radar (hot, rising, stash, fade), weekly positional rankings (ordered by mean, with status, floor, and ceiling on the row), and add/drop (a roster-churn comparison: mean delta and the same 1.5-point toss-up, not a lineup call and not a free-agent claim). Also lists two tools: the toss-up tool, which applies that 1.5-point mean delta to numbers you type, and the certainty tool, which grades how sure that lean is (thin, lean, clear, or strong). Not a news blog, not NFL-affiliated, and not gambling advice.
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/start-sit/ — How to read this desk's start/sit card: listed status first, mean as the ranking number, floor and ceiling as a model range, and certainty as a desk grade rather than a win probability.
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/waiver-radar/ — How to read this desk's waiver radar tags (hot, rising, stash, fade): same estimates plus snap-share change and listed status, not a claim the player is free on any host platform.
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/listed-status/ — What Questionable, Doubtful, Out, injured reserve, and inactive mean on the NFL injury report, and how each one changes a fantasy lineup. Also how Decide Football cards treat the label: a soft discount for Questionable and Doubtful, a hard zero for OUT, IR, and INACTIVE. Not an official injury report or a return date.
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/rankings/ — How to read this desk's weekly positional rankings board: one position ordered by mean, with listed status, floor, and ceiling on the row. A rank is not a start/sit verdict, not an official list, and not a free-agent claim. Certainty is a start/sit grade, not a column on this board.
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/add-drop/ — How to read this desk's add/drop card: a roster-churn comparison of two names, listed status first, mean as the ranking number, floor and ceiling as a model range, and the mean delta against the same 1.5-point toss-up as start/sit. Not a lineup call, not a free-agent or FAAB claim, and not the fixture desk at /add-drop/.
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/toss-up/ — Interactive toss-up tool: type two means and apply this desk's 1.5-point mean-delta line, the same threshold used for start/sit and add/drop. Floor and ceiling are for weighing only. No player search, no projection API, not official projections, and not gambling advice. The certainty grade is a different tool.
- https://decidefootball.com/guide/certainty/ — Interactive certainty tool: type two means and optional desk flags (availability gate, status discount, uncertainty, trailing weeks) and apply the same thin / lean / clear / strong grade the start/sit card prints. A desk grade, not a win probability. No player search, no projection API, not official projections, and not gambling advice.

## Sample / fixture sports pages

Player, start/sit, injury, waiver, add/drop, ranking, slate, and watchlist URLs currently use sample/fixture data. They are for product review only and are not indexable. Do not treat those pages as live, official, or licensed sports data. The reading guide at /guide/add-drop/ is editorial. The sample desk at /add-drop/ is not. The toss-up tool at /guide/toss-up/ and the certainty tool at /guide/certainty/ are editorial and do not use fixture player rows.

Projections are model estimates (methodology v0, subject to change), not official NFL or club figures. There is no published backtest.
